title: Post-TAVR conduction deterioration
patient_context: Following transcatheter aortic valve replacement, a patient develops a new wide-QRS conduction abnormality, intermittent nonconducted P waves, heart rate 36/min, blood pressure 82/48 mmHg, and lightheadedness.

stages.objective: Explain the normal atrioventricular conduction pathway.
Recognize symptomatic bradycardia with hypotension as clinical instability.
Connect postprocedural conduction injury to high-grade AV block and reduced cardiac output.
Prioritize urgent escalation and preparation for pacing per local protocols.
Reassess electrical and mechanical capture and perfusion after pacing.

release_gate: Clinical SME review, source verification, full option/rationale authoring, and assessment QA required before production.
